title: The clay pot
description: A pot shaped by hand from river clay. Hear what it keeps for the house.

lines.text: Come closer, my child. This is our clay pot. We call it ikoko.
A potter shaped it by hand from river clay, then baked it hard in an open fire.
We keep our drinking water in it. The clay breathes, so the water stays cool, even at noon.
ask: Why does the water stay cool?

lines.text: Another pot like this sits on three stones over the fire, and our soup cooks in it.
ask: What do you cook in it?

lines.text: Lift it gently and hold it with both hands. A clay pot that falls does not rise again.
